newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - Sept 16.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Four people have been arrested in connection with the failure of Kreditni Banka Plzen a.s. on various charges of corruption and malpractice. Czech National Bank governer, Josef Tosovsky, called off a foreign trip because of the affair.
- The 38th international construction conference begins in the Moravian capital of Brno on Monday. Representatives from 32 countries will take part.
- Mobile phone company Radiomobil will begin operating its GSM (Global system for mobile) service on September 26.
- In July, 11.7 million tourists visited the Czech Republic, a 9.9 percent increase on the same month in 1995, the Czech Statistical Ofice said.
- The opposition Social Democrats say they favour a balanced budget in 1996.

PRAVO - The Czech Republic retained its position as the number one per capita beer consumer in the world in 1995, at 159 litres per person per year, according to the Confederation of European Union Breweries.
- Czech President Vacalv Havel left for a 14 day official visit to South America on Sunday.
